Ethan P: Heads-up 00k tokens/day POC ask from ContinentalBank. They need: 1) explicit data residency statement for EU, 2) a simple data-flow PNG showing where prompts, outputs, and logs live, 3) CSV of all subprocessors that touch any customer data/metadata, 4) KMS/HSM options and whether they can BYOK, 5) confirm we don't persist prompts by default. Can we turn this around tomorrow?
Sofia R: Yes. For EU-hosted deployments we can pin compute + storage to eu-west-1. We do not replicate prompt content outside that region unless customer requests multi-region.
Liam G: Quick infra notes: default behavior = no prompt persistence. KV cache is in-memory only on the GPU instance and cleared on shutdown. Audit logs are opt-in and, when enabled, write to S3 in the same region.
Nadia V: Subprocessor scope: include anything that processes telemetry, metrics, error events, or stores logs. That means: AWS (EC2/S3), Datadog (metrics), Sentry (errors, redaction applied), and our telemetry pipeline (we use Segment -> internal). I'll prepare the CSV with columns: vendor, service, region, data_types (prompts/metadata/logs), contractual-safeguards.
Ethan P: Good. Also they asked for a redacted diagram for security review and a full unredacted diagram post-SOW. We should be clear on what we redact.
Liam G: For POC redaction we remove internal hostnames, IPs, and service ARNs. Diagram will show logical flow only: client -> regional edge -> auth -> runtime (GPU) -> ephemeral KV -> model -> output -> optional audit-log -> region S3 -> telemetry (redacted).
Sofia R: KMS: Hosted: envelope encryption with AWS KMS (we can use our managed keys or customer-provided CMKs). Private: HSM or customer KMS supported. I'll note which operations require KMS (object store encryption, key wrapping for cache snapshots if ever enabled).
Nadia V: Retention defaults: POC = 30 days for audit logs, metrics retained 90 days in Datadog by default (can vary). Prompts not persisted unless audit logging or debug mode enabled (we should call out dev debug).
LegalBot: DPA + SOC2 summary ready for share. CAIQ snapshot: current export attached. We should include a CAIQ caveat: controls are as of export date.
Ethan P: Pricing question: they want a 2-week reserved pool. Sales policy: 7 days free trial. For 14 days we can do a short-term reserved block (approval needed). @Sofia can you give rough cost delta so I can run approvals?
Sofia R: I'll draft a two-week reserved quote with a 25% trial discount placeholder. Note: enabling audit logs during POC will increase storage charges.
infra-bot: Upload: /internal/pocs/contbank/redacted-dataflow-eu.png (https://internal.s3.redwood/pocs/contbank/redacted-dataflow-eu.png)
Liam G: I'll add a one-pager explaining each node in the diagram and the encryption/retention callouts.
Nadia V: Action items: 1) Sofia: reserve-quote draft; 2) Liam: redacted PNG + one-pager; 3) LegalBot: DPA excerpt + CAIQ export; 4) Ethan: confirm whether they want the CSV with full vendor addresses or just region-level.
Ethan P: I'll ask the customer if region-level is fine. If they insist on addresses we escalate to legal. Thanks all.
Sofia R: ETA: I can drop the quote and CSV link by EOD tomorrow.
Ethan P: Perfect. I'll bundle the diagram + CAIQ + DPA excerpt in the reply to ContinentalBank. :thumbsup:
